name: pixel-index
description: A community index of Pixel Agents office layouts

scripts.//prepare: npm runs this after every install (including a contributor's first `npm ci`/`npm install`), which is what wires up the git hooks in .husky/ — see docs/CONTRIBUTING.md for what they enforce.
scripts.validate: npm run build:core && node packages/layout-core/dist/cli.js seed
scripts.//vendor:commit: A container cannot read the submodule's own git, so the pin ships as a file. --check keeps it from drifting; see tools/vendor-commit.mjs.
scripts.//furniture-categories:schema: The published furniture manifest schema's category enum is generated from the pinned vendor's real bundled manifests, not hand-typed. --check keeps it from drifting; see tools/generate-furniture-categories-schema.mjs.
scripts.//check:mermaid: Parses every mermaid diagram in every tracked markdown file. The `mermaid` devDependency below is pinned exactly and deliberately behind the newest release, because "valid mermaid" only means anything relative to the version github.com renders with; tools/check-mermaid.mjs explains that, why this parses rather than renders, and how to move the pin.
scripts.//lint:md: Style lint over every tracked markdown file (see .markdownlint.json for the two house-style exceptions).
scripts.//check:links: Confirms every relative link in every tracked markdown file resolves to a real file — see tools/check-links.mjs for why http(s) links are deliberately not checked.
scripts.//deps: layout-core is a source dependency of the other workspaces, so its dist has to exist before anything typechecks or tests against it.
scripts.//test: The root suite covers tools/ only — see vitest.tools.config.mjs for why it is passed with --config; the workspaces then run their own.
scripts.test: vitest run --config vitest.tools.config.mjs && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.//lint: One flat config at the repo root covers every workspace plus tools/ (see eslint.config.js), so this is a single eslint run rather than the --workspaces fan-out used by test/typecheck. The lint is type-aware, so it needs layout-core's dist for the same reason typecheck does.
